questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to the underlined word in the sentence? "The experiment yielded *significant* results."
hints: Significant means having a major effect or importance.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct with proper negative inversion?

questions.prompt: Which sentence is grammatically correct with proper negative inversion?

options.text: Hardly have I arrive when the concert began.
Hardly had I arrived when the concert began.
Hardly I had arrived when the concert began.
Hardly did I arrived when the concert began.

hints: Negative words like 'Hardly' trigger inversion of auxiliary verb and subject.
The pattern is 'Hardly + had + subject + past participle'.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly had I arrived when...' correctly applies negative inversion.

options.text: Hardly have I arrive when the concert began.
Hardly had I arrived when the concert began.
Hardly I had arrived when the concert began.
Hardly did I arrived when the concert began.

hints: Negative words like 'Hardly' trigger inversion of auxiliary verb and subject.
The pattern is 'Hardly + had + subject + past participle'.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly had I arrived when...' correctly applies negative inversion.
